limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Qualifies replay claims for historical phases.
limitations.allowed_statement: The historical environment record is incomplete but explicitly delimited.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: Current environment observations are not promoted to complete historical facts.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not describe all historical phases as byte-exactly reproducible.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: The historical EXP04-C execution-time runner is not recoverable.
limitations.allowed_statement: Exact R3 repetition of the historical EXP04-C runner is not recoverable.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: The limitation is historical and nonblocking for approved results.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not relabel the unrecoverable runner as experimental error or invalidate closed results.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: EXP08 v0.1 historical metadata is not recoverable.
limitations.allowed_statement: EXP08 v0.1 metadata was not reconstructed retrospectively.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: The absence is preserved as a historical limitation.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not invent metadata or call the absence proof of invalidity.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: LLM/AI evaluation is not byte-exactly reproducible.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Prevents byte-exact replay claims for AI evaluation.
limitations.allowed_statement: The controlled explanation layer is auditable but not byte-exactly reproducible.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: Explanation is separate from ranking and classification correctness.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim deterministic byte identity or use explanation as validation.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: EXP11A bank size and natural composition are structurally coupled.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Defines the only permitted EXP11A interpretation.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: Size and composition vary together under natural composition.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim an isolated or monotonic causal bank-size effect.

limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Qualifies the acquisition chain without changing frozen outputs.
limitations.allowed_statement: NUEVA_02 acquisition is user-attested and downstream artifacts are frozen.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: Acquisition itself was not independently replayed.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not state that source acquisition was independently reproduced.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: EXP11B bank CSVs and full candidate ranking are local-only and hash/size bound.
limitations.allowed_statement: The local-only artifacts are governed by SHA-256 and size; replay identity passed 20/20.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: Local-only does not mean missing, unverified, invalid, or unreproducible.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim public byte availability or infer scientific invalidity.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: The external auditor did not independently rerun the EXP11B portability runtime.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Qualifies who executed the portability replay.
limitations.allowed_statement: Versioned replay evidence supports portability closure, with the external auditor's runtime scope declared.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: The external auditor reviewed but did not independently rerun the runtime.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim an independently rerun external runtime.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: D1a frozen model weights are local-only and hash/size bound.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Qualifies D1a reproducibility and Attempt06 interpretation.
limitations.allowed_statement: D1a uses frozen local-only weights bound by SHA-256 and size.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not call the weights missing or substitute other weights.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: EXP12 planning ended fail-closed in its consumed one-shot and selected no official conditions.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Explains why diversity effect is not estimable.
limitations.allowed_statement: The frozen planning search did not produce the required minimum unique feasible conditions.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: The result is specific to the frozen search contract.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not assert global infeasibility, characterize other seeds, or reopen retrieval.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: The EXP12 forensic diagnostic is non-governing.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Prevents promotion of forensic evidence to an alternative design decision.
limitations.allowed_statement: The diagnostic documents the failed frozen planning boundary.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: It did not select official conditions and does not govern a redesigned EXP12.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not use it to recommend thresholds, claim global infeasibility, or support/refute HE5.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: The empirical validity boundary is the offline internal Chapter 87 benchmark.
limitations.allowed_statement: Findings apply to the internal offline Chapter 87 benchmark.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: The benchmark contains 1,056 series, 67 DAM, and 42 NANDINA; no external validation was performed.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not generalize to other chapters, countries, administrations, or production.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: Ambiguous or incomplete description prevalence is not estimable.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Supports the INCONCLUSIVE disposition without directional evidence.
limitations.allowed_statement: Description quality was not operationalized as a prevalence estimand.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not create post-hoc text heuristics or infer prevalence.

limitations.allowed_statement: Frozen SAME_CHAPTER, SAME_HS4, and SAME_HS6 counts are descriptive.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: No prospective concentration threshold was frozen.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim error concentration from counts alone.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: Historical-support buckets have no frozen insufficiency threshold.
limitations.allowed_statement: The categories remain 1 DAM, 2 DAM, 3-4 DAM, and 5+ DAM.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: No category is prospectively defined as insufficient.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not relabel a bucket as insufficient.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: EXP11B is descriptive within the ten observed H150/H200 seed pairs.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Prevents invalid independence and superpopulation claims.
limitations.allowed_statement: EXP11B reports paired descriptive sensitivity for the observed H150/H200 conditions.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: Ten seeds are not a frozen superpopulation and 10 x 1056 are not independent observations.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not report inferential generalization across seeds or cases.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: Only corrected Attempt06 is current for 0B-05C interpretation.
limitations.allowed_statement: EV03 is zero aggregate change, EV04 is a tiny nonzero MRR decrease, and D1a has nonzero changes.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: 0B05C impact is method-dependent and nonzero for EV04 MRR and D1a.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not summarize all 0B-05C arms as no numerical impact.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: EXP12 diversity effect is not estimable because no official conditions or retrieval were produced.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Separates frozen-search failure from global feasibility.
limitations.allowed_statement: The planning precondition failed under the frozen search.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: D-HIGH, D-MID, and D-LOW were not selected; retrieval was not authorized or executed.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim global mathematical infeasibility or evidence for/against HE5.

limitations.limitation_text_controlled: Ranking, normative evidence retrieval, and controlled explanation are distinct functions.
limitations.relevance_to_g4_f02: Prevents component evidence from becoming a system or legal claim.
limitations.allowed_statement: The governed components have distinct evaluated roles.
limitations.mandatory_qualification: The local LLM explains preselected candidates.
limitations.forbidden_overclaim: Do not infer end-to-end RAG accuracy, binding legal correctness, or classification correctness from explanation.
